content.short: ChainAware.ai uses AI to audit wallets, detect fraud, and flag rug-pull risk across Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and TON.
content.description: ChainAware.ai is a wallet-risk and fraud-detection product for crypto users and teams. It applies AI models to wallet audits, scam detection, rug-pull checks, and behavioral risk signals across supported chains including TON. AI-based crypto wallet auditor, fraud detector and rug pull detector for Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain and TON. ChainAware.ai - Web3 Agentic Growth Infrastructure. The registry value is risk reduction: audits, analysis, monitoring, or defensive tooling around Web3 systems.
